digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-4 coach catalog / advisory triage
propositions: passes.py is 930 LOC, over the 800-LOC soft cap, and must graduate off the module-size gate.
Extract MOVE_REGISTRY, load_move_registry, APPLY_NOW_MARGIN, and triage_advisories into a new leaf module coach_moves.py along the Pass-4 boundary.
coach_moves.py imports only rebar.llm.review_kernel plus stdlib json and pathlib.Path, holding no back-reference to passes.py to avoid an import cycle.
passes.py re-exports the four moved symbols so passes.* and orchestrator.* consumers keep resolving, and removes its now-unused json and pathlib.Path imports.
pass4_coach stays in passes.py because it depends on passes internals (_resolve_system, PASS_COACH) and moving it would create a circular import.
The stale docs/architecture.md offenders row for passes.py is deleted and passes.py is removed from both module-size gate files.
